exposure: Mode of conception (spontaneous vs. fertility treatments)
outcome: Maternal age at first and second delivery
cohort: Women with their first two consecutive deliveries at the same medical center, excluding those who conceived following fertility treatments or were older than 35 years at their first delivery
finding: Among women without a history of infertility, primary cesarean delivery was not independently associated with the use of fertility treatments in the subsequent delivery, after adjusting for maternal age at second delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery in the first delivery was not independently associated with fertility treatments in the subsequent delivery.
